relations: The buckling leftmost green column causes teal pieces to topple outward left, scattering into a growing loose pile.
As the green edge fails, adjacent yellow dominoes tip and fall, adding yellow pieces to the leftward heap.
The right wall section, pink serpentine chain, light-blue chains, and ruler blocks remain standing and unchanged.
With a fixed camera and wooden floor, the leftward disintegration of green and yellow pieces continues scattering.
caption: The video showcases a domino installation on a wooden floor: a tall grid wall of teal and yellow pieces at the upper center, a pink serpentine chain across the middle, light-blue chains along the bottom and left, and a clear ruler stand with small blocks at the left. The collapse is already underway, with a teal piece airborne and the leftmost green column buckling. The green edge topples outward to the left, tilting and scattering into a growing loose pile. Soon after, yellow dominoes adjacent to the failing green edge begin to tip and fall, adding yellow pieces to the scattered heap on the left. The right portion of the teal-and-yellow wall, the entire pink serpentine chain, the light-blue chains, and the small blocks on the ruler remain standing and unchanged. The camera viewpoint and the wooden background stay fixed, while the leftward disintegration of the green and yellow edge continues to scatter pieces across the floor.
